definitions.explanation: A single serving of food, sized for one person.
Being able to function as a competent, independent person in a given role — whether as an adult, a professional, or a member of society.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧{一人前|ひとりまえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一人前|ひとりまえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十貫|じゅっかん}だ。
examples.english: One serving of sushi is ten pieces.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一人前|ひとりまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}すぎる⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けよう→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: This bento is too much for one person, so let's split it between two.

examples.english: I've finally become a full-fledged adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{半人前|はんにんまえ}→半人前：22681_hanninmae⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、いつか{一人前|ひとりまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I'm still only half-trained, but someday I want to become a fully qualified carpenter.

notes:
{一人前|ひとりまえ} has two distinct uses depending on context.

Sense 1 (portion) is commonly used when ordering food or describing serving sizes.

Sense 2 (full-fledged) describes someone who has reached a level of competence and independence, especially in a profession or as a member of society.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一人前|ひとりまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a full-fledged adult/professional)
- {一人前|ひとりまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きく (to talk big despite being inexperienced)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{半人前|はんにんまえ}→半人前：22681_hanninmae⟧: half-baked, not yet competent — the opposite of sense 2
- {一人前|いちにんまえ}: alternate reading, same meanings
- {二人前|ふたりまえ}: two servings
